title: VERDA Hydrating Conditioner with Aloe, Oat and Rice Protein, 400 mL / 13.5 fl oz
altText: VERDA Hydrating Conditioner in a matte sage green 400 mL bottle with a white flip-top cap
bullets: Made with aloe, oat and rice protein
Two-minute conditioner: apply to clean, wet hair, leave 2 min, rinse
Flip-top cap opens with one hand in the shower
description:
VERDA Hydrating Conditioner is a two-minute conditioner made with aloe, oat and rice protein. It detangles without weigh-down, and it fits easily into your routine as the step that follows shampoo.

Apply to clean, wet hair, leave 2 min, rinse. Work it through the lengths and ends, let it sit while you finish the rest of your shower, then rinse well with water.

The formula pairs aloe barbadensis leaf juice and avena sativa (oat) kernel extract with hydrolyzed rice protein, glycerin and panthenol in a conditioning base. Each matte sage bottle holds 400 mL / 13.5 fl oz and closes with a white flip-top cap that opens with one hand, so it is simple to use with wet hands in the shower.

Ingredients: Aqua (Water), Cetearyl Alcohol, Glycerin, Behentrimonium Chloride, Cetyl Esters, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Extract, Panthenol, Hydrolyzed Rice Protein, Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Parfum (Fragrance).

For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse well with water.
